'''Ulf Stonetotem''' is a [[tauren]] [[blacksmithing]] trainer located in [[Moonhoof Village]] in [[Moonwhisper Coast]].

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Horde|57|The Mighty Elekk}} {{queststartfinish}}
* {{questlong|Horde|57|Brother's Duty}} {{queststart}}

==Quotes==
;Gossip
With each passing day, I miss my younger brother more and more. Yet while I chose the path of the hammer to craft for our tribe, his was a different one. He left home for Bloodhoof Village, where he would one day become a great warrior. As much as I miss him, I dream of the day he returns, a man with a fulfilled goal.
